## v0.5.26: Git sync across machines and memory subagents on DSH 0.2.1 / 跨机器的 Git 同步，以及 DSH 0.2.1 上的记忆子 Agent

Publishes [#335](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/335) and [#357](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/357).
- **Git repository sync**, off by default: sign in with GitHub, push your memory to a repository you own and restore it on another machine. Pushes and pulls are confirmed, merges go through the ZIP backup's importer, an optional automatic backup repeats the push, and **Memory reconciliation** applies a merge plan only after you accept it.
- Memory subagents start on DSH 0.2.1-alpha.2, which removed `subagents.start` (#356). A write to a full USER.md or MEMORY.md, idle review, Save to memory and the other delegated tasks no longer fail there. DSH 0.2.0 is unchanged.
- Runtime Memory reads a stored or imported entry strictly: a malformed branch scope no longer breaks the runtime projection.

发布 [#335](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/335) 与 [#357](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/357)。
- **Git 仓库同步**，默认关闭：用 GitHub 登录，把记忆推送到你自己的仓库，并在另一台机器上恢复。推送与拉取都需要确认，合并走 ZIP 备份的导入路径；可选的自动备份会定时重复推送；**整理记忆**的合并方案只有在你接受后才会执行。
- 记忆子 Agent 可以在移除了 `subagents.start` 的 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.2 上启动（#356）。USER.md 或 MEMORY.md 写满后的写入、空闲审查、存入记忆等委派任务不再失败。DSH 0.2.0 上的行为不变。
- 运行时记忆严格读取已存储或导入的条目：格式错误的分支范围不再让运行时投影出错。

The Starter advances to **0.5.26** and Runtime Memory to **0.5.14**. The other 16 component versions are unchanged.

Starter 升至 **0.5.26**，运行时记忆升至 **0.5.14**；其余 16 个组件版本不变。

From v0.5.22, use **Memory System → Status → Check versions → Update**, then restart DSH. Or install the exact version:

从 v0.5.22 可使用**记忆系统 → 状态 → 检查版本 → 更新**，然后重启 DSH；也可安装精确版本：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.26
```

No memory migration is required. 无需迁移已有记忆。
